review.verdict: Fails: the two-story split isn't legible as two stories, the door-peek reads as a scanner gate, and the whisper-bot is cropped off-canvas and disconnected from the exam-taker, breaking the central 'whispering' metaphor.
revisionNotes: Whisper-bot is clipped off the right edge and floats far from the exam-taker — re-anchor it to attachTo exam-taker, side right, with offset roughly (-50,-80) and scale ~0.45 so it visibly leans toward the ear instead of hovering outside the safe area.

The 'building with cracked door' doesn't read: the window-grid rect overlaps directly behind the ex-boss's legs with no visible door shape, so it looks like a security scanner gate. Separate the door into its own raw shape with a clear gap/sliver of light and pull ex-boss forward off the panel.
Brief calls for a thin vertical divider splitting two scenes; it's missing, so the comeback story and the cheating story blend into one ambiguous tableau. Add the divider line down the middle.
Camera-button prop lands near the exam-taker's temple/eyebrow where it reads as a wound, not a collar light — move it down to the collar/shoulder anchor as scened.

Composition (beige-top/blue-horizon split, red-accent robot upper right, two blue-gray humans) closely repeats the layout of several recent sloppers — vary the horizon color or shift the focal cluster to differentiate.
Once whisper-bot is repositioned, double check no part of it leaves the 1080 safe area per the lint warning before finalizing.

review.verdict: Casting is correct and the right-hand cheating scene reads clearly, but the left 'comeback' scene is broken by an overlap/transparency bug that makes the person look fused with the door rather than peeking through it, and the robot clips the canvas edge — fails on clarity, composition, and polish.
revisionNotes: Fix the rendering bug on 'ex-boss': the body is drawing translucent over the door/building, letting the window square and door line show through the chest and arms. Reorder z-index so the person is fully opaque in front of the door.

The left scene doesn't read as 'peeking through a half-open door' — right now the person looks pasted onto the door front-on. Pull the door open with a visible gap (add an r-glow sliver at the hinge) and offset the person so only their head/shoulder shows through the gap.

whisper-bot's arm and hand are clipped at the right edge (lint: extends outside safe area, x 844-1077); scale it to ~0.4 and shift offset left another 40-50px so the whole robot, including the raised arm, sits inside the safe margin.

The split-panel-with-center-divider composition (building left, person+robot right) is very close to a recent slopper's layout (CHIEF RESIGNS / RIVAL LAUNCHES). Vary the divider or stagger the scenes to feel less templated.

At the exam-taker's feet, the desk legs and the body's drop-shadow merge into one dark blob — nudge exam-desk legs apart from the body shadow or lighten the shadow so the base doesn't read as clutter.

review.verdict: The left panel misreads as a scanning booth rather than a building with a cracked door, the hidden-camera button is missing, and the robot's arm overlaps the exam-taker's mouth awkwardly — the joke doesn't land clearly enough, and the diagonal split-panel layout repeats recent work, so this fails.
revisionNotes: Left panel reads as an x-ray/scanner booth, not a building with a cracked door; redesign so the door-slab clearly separates from a recognizable building silhouette (roofline, door frame) with a visible gap, not a sealed box.

The camera-button prop (glowing hidden-camera button on the exam-taker's collar) is missing or unreadable in the render; scale it up to at least 1.0 and push its glow so the 'caught on camera' beat is visible.
Whisper-bot's arm/offset overlaps the exam-taker's mouth instead of the ear, reading like it's feeding something into the mouth; move the attach offset up and right so the arm gestures near the ear.

Ex-boss's 'proud' mood renders as a broad open smile inside an enclosed box, which contradicts the 'quiet, peeking return' concept; swap to a cautious/furtive mood and open the door-slab gap so the face is only partly visible.

This diagonal-divider, two-panel split composition is very close to several recent sloppers (e.g. the paused/twice-as-fast and blueprint pieces); vary the panel shapes or stagger them instead of a single angled line.
Consider adding a subtle roof or signage-free window row to the building so it isn't confused with machinery.
